about: Pictures the checks must reject. Code cases are measured again by tests/controls.test.mjs for free. Witness cases are real pilot attempts: the test confirms the code checks pass them (so only the witness can stop them) and that the recorded answers fail the witness rule.

code.note: The bakery hero passes with its real text zone (left half). Move white body text to the top 40% and the worst 2% of pixels fall below 4.5:1; a 9% dark scrim fixes it, so make reports PASS WITH SCRIM.
White text on pale paper: about 1.6:1.
A slot with a 60 KB limit (an email header, say).
Right final size, but stretched 2.5x from what the model drew.
The zine hero averaged to one colour: what a blank or failed render looks like.

witness.note: z-image drew a banner of made-up words. Every code check passes; only the witness sees the text. Answers from palette-rewitness.json: this try had stopped at the palette rule during make.
Stickers with lettering. Four of six tote attempts had text and the other two lost the tote, so the slot stayed FAILED and kept its placeholder.
The last repair removed the text and the tote bag with it.
